lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance pixel clusters are distributed in roughly five vertical columns posterior to the gill region. The arrangement shows a semi-regular grid with vertical spacing between centroids being narrower than the horizontal spacing between columns.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the primary circular blobs, forming a discernible rectilinear lattice across the mid-to-upper lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent longitudinal ridge feature is present in the upper third of the visible flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient with a highlight on the dorsal edge and a shadow in the ventral trough.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct dark circular lesion or focal hyper-pigmentation is visible on the posterior distal surface of the pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple small, elongated teleost silhouettes (remoras) in close proximity to the ventral aspect of the pectoral fin.
